Food safety

Allergen Information

Please check allergen information before placing an order, especially if you have a food allergy, intolerance or coeliac disease.

Important — check before you order

Recipes, suppliers, brands and substitutions can change. Dexter’s staff must never guess about allergens. If the item-specific information you need is not displayed in the ordering screen, contact Dexter’s before completing your order so the current written recipe, ingredient and allergen information can be checked.

Call: 0141 473 5249
Email: hello@dextersspot.co.uk

The 14 regulated allergens

Celery
Cereals containing gluten
Crustaceans
Eggs
Fish
Lupin
Milk
Molluscs
Mustard
Peanuts
Sesame
Soya
Sulphur dioxide / sulphites
Tree nuts

Item-specific information

Allergen information for the exact food, sauce, drink, side, topping, modifier or substitution being considered must be available before the purchase is concluded. Where it is not displayed directly online, ask Dexter’s before ordering and staff will check the current written allergen record, recipe and relevant product information without charge.

Distance and collection orders

For orders made through the website, Loyalty App, phone or other distance method, mandatory allergen information must be available to the customer before the purchase is concluded and again when the food is supplied. Dexter’s should provide the information in writing with the food or make it available verbally at supply in accordance with the applicable rules. The information must be current, accurate and provided without an additional charge.

Cross-contact

Dexter’s prepares a wide range of foods in a shared working kitchen. Cross-contact may be possible depending on ingredients, equipment, fryers, utensils, storage and preparation methods. Staff should check the current process for the specific order rather than making a general “allergen free” or “safe” promise that cannot be verified.

Serious allergies and coeliac disease

Tell Dexter’s about a serious allergy or coeliac requirement before placing the order and remind staff when collecting. This allows the kitchen to check the current recipe, product labels, preparation method and known cross-contact risks. If Dexter’s cannot verify the information or manage the risk safely, staff must say so rather than guess.

Staff procedure

  • Never guess whether an allergen is present.
  • Use the current written recipe, product label and allergen record.
  • Check sauces, toppings, sides, drinks, modifiers and substitutions as well as the main item.
  • Check shared fryers, utensils, surfaces and other known cross-contact routes where relevant.
  • If information cannot be confirmed, tell the customer before the order is concluded.
  • If an ingredient or supplier changes, update the written allergen information before relying on it.
Last reviewed: 4 September 2026. This information is designed for Dexter’s operations in Scotland and must be maintained alongside current kitchen allergen records, recipes and supplier labels.

Dexter’s Catering

Food for your team, party or event.

Tell us what you need and we’ll help put the order together. Catering orders require a minimum of 48 hours’ notice and remain subject to availability and Dexter’s confirmation.

View full menuChat on WhatsApp with Dexter AI

Planning a catering order?

We can cater using items from the current Dexter’s menu. For larger or more complex orders, availability may vary, so please contact us before relying on a particular item or quantity.

Minimum 48 hours’ noticeCollection arrangements confirmed with youAllergen information checked separately

Good for

  • Work lunches and meetings
  • Birthday and family gatherings
  • Community events
  • Team meals
  • Small parties and celebrations
  • Bulk breakfast, lunch or hot-food orders

How to start

Browse our current menu, then email hello@dextersspot.co.uk or message Dexter AI on WhatsApp. We’ll send you the catering order form so everything is captured clearly.

Please don’t send card details, passwords or other sensitive information by email or WhatsApp.

Choose from the menu

Use the live Loyalty App menu for the current customer-facing selection and pricing.

Open Dexter’s Loyalty App

Tell us what you need

We’ll ask for:

  • event or collection date and preferred time
  • number of people
  • exact food items and quantities
  • drinks and extras
  • vegetarian or other dietary requirements
  • allergies and intolerances
  • budget, if relevant
  • name, phone number and email
  • packaging or special instructions

We confirm the order

Your catering request is not confirmed until Dexter’s has checked availability, agreed the details with you and confirmed the order. We may ask for payment or a deposit depending on the size and nature of the order.

Allergies & intolerances

If anyone in your group has a food allergy or intolerance, tell us before the order is confirmed. Do not rely on menu names alone. Ingredients, recipes and supplier products can change.

We will provide the allergen information available for the specific items being ordered. Because food is prepared in a working kitchen, we cannot promise an allergen-free environment unless we have specifically confirmed that in writing for the item concerned.

Read allergen information

Need an answer quickly?

For general questions, Dexter AI on WhatsApp may be the quickest option. For final catering confirmation, allergens, availability or payment, a member of the Dexter’s team may still need to confirm the details.

Complaints Policy

Contact Dexter’s

If something has gone wrong with an order, payment, reward, account or service, contact Dexter’s as soon as reasonably possible.

Dexters
10A Dundasvale Court
Glasgow
G4 0JS
Scotland

Email hello@dextersspot.co.uk or call 0141 473 5249.

Information that helps us investigate

Where relevant, provide your name, order/reference number, date/time, the issue, photographs or other evidence and the outcome you are seeking. Do not send full payment-card details or passwords.

How complaints are handled

Dexter’s should acknowledge and investigate complaints fairly, review relevant order and system records, and provide an appropriate response or remedy where one is due. Food-safety or allergen complaints should be treated as urgent and escalated internally.

Privacy complaints

For concerns about personal information, use the same contact details. Customers also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.

Consumer rights

Contacting Dexter’s first does not remove or delay any statutory right or remedy. Customers may use available court, regulatory, card/payment-provider or consumer remedies where applicable.

Scotland

Dexter’s operates in Scotland. These complaint arrangements do not prevent a customer from seeking independent advice, including from Citizens Advice Scotland or an appropriate regulator where relevant.

Privacy information

Cookie & Local Storage Policy

What the app uses

The Dexter’s website and Loyalty App may use cookies, browser local storage, session storage and similar technologies to keep customers signed in, protect accounts, remember essential preferences, prevent duplicate rewards and operate core app functions.

Strictly necessary technologies

Technologies that are strictly necessary to provide a service requested by the customer, maintain security or complete core app functions may be used without optional marketing consent where permitted by UK law.

Non-essential technologies

Analytics, advertising, profiling or similar non-essential technologies must not be set or accessed until any consent required by UK privacy and electronic communications law has been obtained. Consent must be freely given, specific and informed, and customers must be able to withdraw it as easily as they gave it.

Third parties

Service providers may use technologies necessary to provide authentication, hosting, payment or communications services. Dexter’s should keep an up-to-date record of the technologies actually used, their purposes and retention periods, and update this policy if new non-essential services are introduced.

Your choices

Where optional technologies are used, the app should provide a clear way to accept or reject them before activation and a way to revisit those choices later. Blocking strictly necessary storage in browser settings may prevent sign-in or other core functions from working correctly.

UK GDPR customer information

Privacy & Data Protection

How Dexter’s handles personal information used by the website, Loyalty App, collection ordering, rewards, promotions and Sunday Roast pre-orders.

Who is responsible for your data?

Data controller: Dexters, 10A Dundasvale Court, Glasgow, G4 0JS, Scotland. The customer-facing brand may be displayed as Dexter’s. For privacy requests, email hello@dextersspot.co.uk or call 0141 473 5249.

Personal information we collect

  • Name, email address, phone number and account identifiers.
  • Loyalty stamps, points, rewards, offers, promotion entries and redemption history.
  • Order contents, modifiers, notes, collection times, order status and transaction references.
  • Sunday Roast booking information, deposit reference and payment status. Full card details are processed by the payment provider and are not intended to be stored by Dexter’s.
  • Authentication, device/browser, IP, security and technical information needed to operate and protect the service.
  • Messages, enquiries, complaints and catering information you send to Dexter’s.

Why we use information and lawful bases

  • Contract: to create and operate customer accounts, process orders and deposits, provide requested loyalty benefits and deal with requests linked to an order or service.
  • Legitimate interests: to secure and improve the service, prevent fraud and duplicate rewards, troubleshoot faults, maintain proportionate business records and provide customer support, where those interests are not overridden by your rights.
  • Legal obligation: where records or disclosures are necessary for tax, accounting, food-safety, consumer, regulatory or other legal requirements.
  • Consent: where consent is required, including certain non-essential cookies/technologies or marketing communications.

Providing information

Some personal information is needed to create an account, place an order, take payment, provide a reward or respond to a request. If required information is not provided, Dexter’s may be unable to provide that particular service. Information requested only for optional marketing or non-essential features is not required to buy food.

Who we share information with

Dexter’s uses service providers for hosting, database/authentication, payments, email and communications. Current services include Vercel, Supabase, Stripe and Google/Gmail, and WhatsApp/Meta when a customer chooses that communication channel. Information is shared only where reasonably necessary for the relevant service, legal obligation, security purpose or customer request.

International transfers

Some service providers may process information outside the UK. Where UK data-protection law requires safeguards, Dexter’s relies on an applicable UK adequacy regulation, the UK International Data Transfer Agreement/Addendum or another lawful transfer mechanism made available by the relevant provider. Customers may contact Dexter’s for information about the applicable safeguards.

How long we keep information

Dexter’s keeps information only for as long as needed for the purpose for which it was collected, including fulfilment, customer support, fraud/security, accounting, tax, legal claims and food-safety obligations. Account and loyalty information is generally retained while the account remains active and for a reasonable period afterwards where needed for deletion, security, dispute or legal purposes. Order and payment-reference records are retained for the period required by applicable accounting, tax and legal obligations. Retention periods and criteria must be reviewed when systems or legal requirements change.

Your UK data-protection rights

Depending on the circumstances and lawful basis, you may have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw consent at any time and it must be as easy to withdraw as to give. Requests can be made using the contact details above.

Your right to object: where Dexter’s relies on legitimate interests, you may object to that processing in relevant circumstances. You have an absolute right to object to direct marketing.

Complaints to the ICO

You may complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office if you are unhappy with how your personal information is handled. Information is available at ico.org.uk. Dexter’s would welcome the opportunity to resolve the issue first, but this does not remove your right to contact the ICO.

Cookies and local storage

Browser storage and similar technologies may be used where strictly necessary for sign-in, security, preferences and core app functions. Non-essential analytics, advertising or similar technologies must not be set or accessed until any consent required by UK privacy law has been obtained. See the Cookie & Local Storage Policy.

Security and data breaches

Dexter’s uses authentication, access controls, role restrictions, one-time reward checks and security features supplied by its service providers. Staff credentials must not be shared. Access should be limited to authorised users and reviewed when roles change. No internet service can guarantee absolute security. Suspected personal-data breaches must be investigated promptly and reported to the ICO and affected individuals where UK data-protection law requires it.

Automated decisions

Reward and promotion systems may automatically determine whether a QR code is valid, whether points have already been credited or whether a promotional result applies. Dexter’s does not intend to make solely automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects on customers without providing the information and safeguards required by law.

Changes to this notice

This notice may be updated when Dexter’s changes its services, suppliers, legal structure, data uses or legal requirements. Material changes should be brought to customers’ attention where appropriate.

Dexter’s rewards

Receipt QR Reward Promotion

Terms for the chance to receive a free coffee or cake when an eligible Dexter’s Loyalty App receipt QR is scanned.

Promoter

Promoter: Dexters, 10A Dundasvale Court, Glasgow, G4 0JS, Scotland. The customer-facing brand may be displayed as Dexter’s. Contact hello@dextersspot.co.uk or 0141 473 5249.

How to take part

  • Place an eligible collection order through the Dexter’s Loyalty App.
  • The order must be completed and marked Collected.
  • Sign in to the same customer account and scan that order’s one-time receipt QR.
  • The first valid scan for that eligible order enters/checks the promotion. Repeated scans do not create extra entries.

No separate entry fee is charged. Customers pay the normal advertised price for their food whether or not this promotion is available. Dexter’s does not set or increase the price of food to reflect the opportunity to participate in this promotion.

Eligibility

The promotion is available to genuine Dexter’s Loyalty App customer accounts completing eligible app collection orders. Staff/admin test accounts, fraudulent accounts, duplicated receipts and technical-abuse attempts are not eligible through the customer claim route. Any age or geographic restriction introduced in future must be clearly stated before entry.

How results are determined

Eligible first-time receipt scans are processed automatically by the Dexter’s promotion system using the promotion mechanics configured for the relevant period. If a receipt is selected as a winner, the app assigns the prize shown. Dexter’s must administer the promotion fairly and must not alter a genuine result after entry except to correct fraud, duplicate use, tampering or an obvious technical error.

Prize

The prize is one free coffee or one free cake, as shown in the winning customer’s app. The prize is personal to the customer account, can be redeemed once, has no cash alternative and cannot be exchanged for cash. If the exact item is unavailable, Dexter’s may offer a reasonable equivalent of similar nature/value where appropriate.

Points are separate

Sunday Roast Deposit & Refund Policy

Deposit

A £4.99 deposit is required for each adult or kids Sunday Roast meal ordered. The deposit is part-payment of the meal price, not an additional charge. Extras do not create another £4.99 deposit unless clearly stated before ordering.

Remaining balance

The deposit is deducted from the full order total. The remaining balance is due on collection. Adult roast £14.99 = £4.99 deposit + £10.00 balance. Kids roast £9.99 = £4.99 deposit + £5.00 balance. Multiple meals and extras are calculated as the full order total less deposits already paid.

Customer cancellation

Sunday Roasts are fresh food prepared for a specific collection date/time and may fall within exceptions to ordinary distance-selling cancellation rights for rapidly perishable goods. If you need to cancel, contact Dexter’s as soon as possible. Where preparation has not begun and Dexter’s can reasonably release the reserved food/slot without loss, Dexter’s may refund the deposit. Once ingredients have been specifically committed, preparation has begun or the agreed collection time is imminent, the deposit may be retained to reflect the reserved food and preparation commitment, subject always to statutory rights.

Failure to collect

If a customer fails to collect at the agreed time without prior agreement, the deposit will normally be retained because food, preparation time and a collection slot were reserved for that order. Any amount retained must not remove a remedy the customer is legally entitled to.

When Dexter’s cancels or cannot fulfil

If Dexter’s cancels the order or cannot provide the ordered meal, the applicable deposit and any other amount paid for the unavailable order will be refunded through the appropriate payment route unless the customer voluntarily accepts an agreed alternative.

Problems with the food or service

Nothing in this policy limits rights where food is unsafe, faulty, not as described, or where a service is not supplied with reasonable care and skill. Contact Dexter’s promptly so the issue can be investigated and an appropriate remedy provided where due.

Failed or incomplete payment

A Sunday Roast order is not confirmed until the required deposit is successfully processed and the ordering flow confirms acceptance. If payment fails, is cancelled or expires, no confirmed pre-order is created unless Dexter’s separately confirms otherwise.

Collection and loyalty points

The outstanding balance must be paid before the order is treated as fully paid/collected. Eligible loyalty points are awarded under the current Loyalty Programme rules once the qualifying order is completed.

Allergens

Review Allergen Information before placing the pre-order. Allergen information must be available before purchase is concluded and again when the food is supplied.
